title: Wendy and the Two Kinds of Wind
synopsis: Wendy travels east with Aunt Kay, meets Todd, and helps fill the sound book with the different rustles of two meadows.
continuity_state: Before: Wendy knows Willow Bend but has not visited Reed Meadow or met Todd; book has three pages; banner stays inside her cottage. After: Wendy and Todd have met; Wendy knows Reed Meadow east of Round Pond; fourth sound-book page contrasts fluttering Windbreak Tree leaves and shushing reeds; hat’s blue ribbon remains attached; banner remains at cottage.
